project.name: NayaNET Personal World — Illustrative Factory Brief
project.pi_ref: Resolve the current Personal World Project Intelligence before dispatch
project.source_of_truth: Current NayaNET PI, canonical design law, app data contracts, and verified repository/runtime state
project.owner: Product owner to be confirmed during PI restoration

outcome.primary_user: A person organizing their own life, work, relationships, and interests
outcome.job: See what matters now in their world and move naturally to the next useful action
outcome.success: The person can identify the important current state, understand why it matters, and complete a permitted next action without searching across disconnected apps
non_goals: Do not fabricate personal data, relationships, activity, recommendations, or scores
Do not claim private memory, automation, or cloud synchronization until the corresponding capability is verified
Do not duplicate canonical identity, events, notes, or ledger records
measures: Task completion on the primary Today journey
Time to locate the next relevant item
User comprehension of source and freshness

design_authority.app_contract_ref: Resolve the current NayaNET product boundary and Personal World PI before build
human_director_decisions: Preserve the canonical Naya visual and interaction grammar
One dominant focal point per screen; use progressive disclosure
Do not claim a feature or data source is live without evidence

app_shell.navigation_model: Shared NayaNET shell with contextual Personal World rooms; navigation is a projection, not a second source of truth
app_shell.global_context: The currently authenticated person and their authorized Personal World scope
app_shell.search_policy: Expose universal search only when the actual search capability is integrated and permission-aware; otherwise show a truthful unavailable or scoped state
persistent_elements: Clear app identity and current room
Accessible global search entry when available

data_contracts.source_ref: PI and canonical owner-scoped work-item source must be resolved before implementation
data_contracts.freshness: Unknown until a verified read path and refresh policy are identified
data_contracts.owner_scope: Authenticated owner only unless explicit sharing grants access
data_contracts.permission_ref: Resolve current authorization/RLS contract before build
data_contracts.derivation: Priority ranking must cite the source fields and ranking rule; no invented score
data_contracts.empty_state: Nothing requiring attention is currently available from the connected source.
data_contracts.error_state: The source could not be read. No items or counts are inferred.

data_contracts.entity: People and spaces the person is permitted to discover or manage
data_contracts.source_ref: Resolve canonical people/space records and public/private search rules
data_contracts.freshness: Unknown until current source and cache policy are proven
data_contracts.owner_scope: Publicly discoverable fields plus explicitly authorized private relationship fields
data_contracts.permission_ref: Resolve discovery, consent, and relationship authorization rules
data_contracts.derivation: Match scores, if present, must expose real reasons and never imply consent or a connection
data_contracts.empty_state: No discoverable connections are available in this scope yet.
data_contracts.error_state: Connections could not be loaded. Existing relationships are not changed.

data_contracts.entity: A summary of meaningful activity and progress
data_contracts.source_ref: Resolve the canonical event/ledger/read model and exact aggregation windows
data_contracts.freshness: Unknown until the source's update cadence is verified
data_contracts.permission_ref: Resolve current owner-scope and field-level access rules
data_contracts.derivation: Every metric must define units, time window, deduplication, and source
data_contracts.empty_state: There is not enough verified activity to show this report yet.
data_contracts.error_state: The report source is unavailable. No fallback or demo values are presented as real.

component_manifest.role: Reference hero composition for orientation and one dominant first-glance purpose
component_manifest.use_when: A screen genuinely needs a prominent title/orientation block
component_manifest.avoid_when: A task-first screen or compact mobile view would benefit from a direct focal object instead
component_manifest.override_policy: Preserve the canonical specimen and adapt only its documented content slots

component_manifest.role: Reference content board for a meaningful grouped surface
component_manifest.use_when: Several related data elements need one coherent, readable context
component_manifest.override_policy: Preserve the source material and interaction invariants

component_manifest.use_when: One consequential primary action deserves the strongest action treatment
component_manifest.override_policy: Bind to a real action contract; do not use as decoration

component_manifest.use_when: The person must enter or edit text
component_manifest.override_policy: Preserve labels, validation, focus, keyboard, and input semantics

component_manifest.use_when: The person must choose from a known, bounded set
component_manifest.override_policy: Preserve accessible expanded, selected, disabled, and error states

screens.job: Help the person see the most important current item and decide what to do next
screens.entry_context: The person enters their Personal World or selects Today from the shared navigation
screens.exit_condition: The person opens an item, completes a permitted action, or moves to another room
screens.back_behavior: Return to the prior context without losing the selected item or unsaved work

first_view.orientation: Show the room identity and explain the current scope in one short line
first_view.focal_point: The most important verified item requiring attention, with a reason and source freshness
supporting_items: A concise summary of other waiting work
secondary_actions: Create a note, only when the real capture capability is wired

sections.purpose: Present the single most relevant item and explain why it is first
sections.disclosure_rule: Show the reasoning summary first; expose source fields and history on demand

sections.purpose: Show the remaining waiting items in a scannable list
sections.disclosure_rule: Show a useful preview and open the full list when requested

actions.label: Open item
actions.intent: Inspect the selected item and its evidence
actions.authority: Must resolve the current read authorization and route contract before implementation
preconditions: The item exists in the canonical source
The owner is permitted to read it
actions.effect: Navigate to the canonical item detail view without duplicating the item
actions.success_signal: The exact item and its source metadata are visible
actions.failure_recovery: Show a truthful unavailable/forbidden state and preserve navigation context

actions.label: Create note
actions.intent: Capture a thought related to the current work
actions.scope: The owner's private note scope unless explicitly shared
actions.authority: Must resolve the canonical Smart Note capture and owner-scope authorization before implementation
preconditions: The note capture capability is available
The user has permission to create a note
actions.effect: Create one canonical note and return its authoritative reference
actions.success_signal: The saved note can be reopened by its canonical reference
actions.failure_recovery: Preserve the draft and report the failure without claiming the note was saved

states.presentation: A calm loading state explains that today's items are being retrieved
states.recovery: Keep the user in context and announce completion

states.presentation: The source is not connected or not yet proven; no sample items or counts are shown
states.recovery: Explain what connection or decision is required

states.presentation: No items requiring attention are currently available from the verified source
states.recovery: Offer a relevant next step only when that capability is real

states.presentation: The source could not be read; show the scope and time of the failure
states.recovery: Allow a safe retry without duplicating work

responsive.small: Single-column task-first composition; focal item first; navigation must not cover the action or keyboard
responsive.medium: One main column with an optional supporting column only when both remain readable
responsive.large: Use available width for a deliberate main/support composition, not oversized empty margins

acceptance: At first glance, the person can identify the room, the focal item, and why it matters
An unknown or unavailable data source never displays invented live items or counts
The open-item action resolves to the same canonical item and preserves owner scope
The note action is hidden or honestly disabled until its real capability and authorization are verified
The first viewport remains useful at 320, 390, 768, and 1440 CSS px without clipping or obscured actions
The page does not require horizontal scrolling except an explicitly specified two-dimensional data region

screens.job: Help the person discover and manage relevant people and spaces without confusing a suggestion with a relationship or consent
screens.entry_context: The person opens Connections from the Personal World navigation
screens.exit_condition: The person inspects a person/space or performs a permitted connection action
screens.back_behavior: Return to the previous room with the search/filter context preserved

first_view.orientation: Explain what can be discovered in the person's current permission scope
supporting_items: Visible distinction between suggestions and established connections
first_view.primary_action: Search within the available discoverable scope

sections.purpose: Find people and spaces the user is allowed to discover
sections.disclosure_rule: Explain each result and why it is shown; do not expose private content

sections.purpose: Show established relationships separately from suggestions
sections.disclosure_rule: Use an explicit relationship state and consent record

actions.label: Search
actions.intent: Find a person or space by permitted public/discoverable fields
actions.scope: Only the discoverable fields and objects authorized for the user
actions.authority: Must resolve the live Smart Search and privacy contract before implementation
preconditions: The query is scoped and authorized
actions.effect: Return ranked, explainable results without exposing private fields
actions.success_signal: Results show clear names, context, and match reasons
actions.failure_recovery: Show unavailable/error state and retain the query

actions.label: Request connection
actions.intent: Ask another person to establish a relationship
actions.scope: The target relationship and consent workflow
actions.authority: Must resolve the current relationship, consent, and invitation capability before implementation
preconditions: The user has authority to request
actions.effect: Create a request that remains distinct from an accepted connection
actions.success_signal: The request status is visible and attributable
actions.failure_recovery: Show the reason and allow retry only when safe

states.presentation: No discoverable results match this query
Discovery is not available in this scope yet
states.recovery: Explain the missing integration or access decision

states.presentation: The requested profile or field is not visible to this user
states.recovery: Return to the safe results view

states.presentation: The search service failed; do not substitute a demo result
states.recovery: Retain the query and offer retry

responsive.small: Single-column results with touch-sized filters and no hover-only menus
responsive.medium: Search and results use a split layout only where the content remains readable
responsive.large: Optional persistent filter/context column with results as the dominant work area

acceptance: Suggestions are visually and semantically distinct from established connections
Search results include a meaningful explanation and never expose unauthorized private fields
A request remains pending until a real acceptance event occurs
No action silently creates a connection or implies consent
The screen remains usable with touch, keyboard, narrow reflow, and zoom

screens.job: Help the person understand meaningful progress and make a better decision from it
screens.entry_context: The person opens Reports from the Personal World navigation or an explicit insight link
screens.exit_condition: The person understands a finding, changes a date range, or opens supporting evidence
screens.back_behavior: Return to the prior context and restore the selected date range

first_view.orientation: Name the question and exact time window the report answers
first_view.focal_point: The most useful verified trend or finding for the selected period

sections.purpose: State the principal finding in human language
sections.disclosure_rule: Show the answer first, then the metric definition and source

sections.purpose: Show change over the selected time range
sections.disclosure_rule: Keep labels readable and offer a text/data alternative

sections.purpose: Explain the definition, calculation, exclusions, and source
sections.disclosure_rule: Available on demand without hiding critical caveats

actions.label: View evidence
actions.intent: Inspect the canonical records behind a finding
actions.scope: Only evidence within the report's permission scope
actions.authority: Must resolve the source record read contract before implementation
preconditions: Evidence references exist and are readable
actions.effect: Open the authoritative records without creating duplicate report data
actions.success_signal: The source records, definitions, and time window can be inspected
actions.failure_recovery: State that evidence is unavailable rather than implying the finding is proven

actions.label: Change period
actions.authority: Local view state only; source permission must be preserved
preconditions: The selected period is supported by the data source
actions.effect: Recompute the same report definition for the selected period
actions.success_signal: The report labels and data update together
actions.failure_recovery: Restore the prior valid period and show why the selection failed

states.presentation: Show the metric/report is being assembled
states.recovery: Announce when the selected range is ready

states.presentation: There is not enough verified data for this range
states.recovery: Offer another valid range if available

states.presentation: Show the time of the last successful refresh
states.recovery: Offer an explicit refresh when supported

states.presentation: The source or metric definition is not yet verified
states.recovery: Do not substitute a synthetic chart

states.presentation: The data could not be loaded or calculated
states.recovery: Preserve the selected period and allow safe retry

responsive.small: One chart/insight at a time, readable labels, accessible data table or summary, page scroll
responsive.medium: One main visualization with a concise supporting insight column
responsive.large: Main trend and supporting breakdown in a clear grid with generous readable spacing

acceptance: Every displayed metric has a definition, unit, time window, and authoritative source
A chart has a text/data alternative and meaningful axis labels
A missing or stale source is not presented as live
Opening evidence resolves to canonical source records
Changing the period updates the chart, labels, summary, and comparison consistently
The report works at 320 CSS px reflow without horizontal page scrolling

human_approval_required_for: changes to ratified design or governance law
privacy policy or data visibility changes
financial, destructive, external-send, publication, or permission-changing actions
production promotion where the release contract requires approval
hard_gates: No unauthorized read or write path
Every visible action has a real capability and recovery behavior
Primary user journey is complete and independently tested
No clipping or inaccessible critical interaction at required viewports
WCAG 2.2 AA target and stricter Naya house control-size rule are verified
All required app standard features are evaluated by the existing 13-feature gate
